text:
hana: Quick kickoff for relnotes 1.13.0. Scope: schema-driven structured output feature blurb, short migration checklist, tiny Node + Python cookbooks snippets, and a Known Issues / FAQ entry about top-level arrays. Need someone to own Node snippet and someone to own the migration checklist.

leo: I can take the Node snippet and trim it for the cookbooks section. Will pull from examples/cookbooks/structured-output. Will keep it minimal.

sam: I'll own the migration checklist and the 3-row mapping table (old->new->note). Reminder: param rename `response_format` -> `structured_output` and client init now uses `new Redwood(...)`. Will draft one-paragraph migration guidance.

nina: I'll run the internal link-scan once PR is open. Last time docs-bot flagged an old anchor under /docs/sdk#legacy-init. If we keep the headings consistent, we should point to /docs/sdk#initializing-client.

docs-bot: link-scan: internal anchor detected -> /docs/sdk#legacy-init (404). Suggested replacement: /docs/sdk#initializing-client.

leo: Node snippet (cookbook-minimal):
```js
// Node minimal (cookbook)
const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
const out = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', structured_output: { type: 'json' }, prompt: 'Summarize the ticket' });
console.log(out);
```

sam: Migration checklist paragraph (draft): "SDK v2 migration notes: instantiate with `new Redwood({ apiKey })` instead of `createClient()`, and rename `response_format` to `structured_output`. Structured_output is schema-driven and enforces stricter validation for top-level arrays—wrap arrays in an object (e.g., `{ items: [...] }`) as a workaround. Update your cookbooks and quickstarts accordingly."

sam: Mapping table (3 rows):
| old | new | note |
|---|---|---|
| response_format | structured_output | rename + schema validation |
| createClient() | new Redwood() | constructor API updated |
| examples/structured-output | cookbooks/structured-output | moved to cookbooks folder |

nina: Please include the mapping table in the migration guide and add a short FAQ bullet under Known Issues. I'll watch the PR and run `scripts/link-check.sh --subset releases` on the preview.

docs-bot: preview-build: started for PR #2707 (relnotes/1.13.0). ETA ~3m.

hana: Frontmatter to drop into content/releases/1.13.0.md:
---
release: "2026-06-10"
version: "1.13.0"
notes: |
  - Schema-driven structured output: new JSON-schema quickstarts and cookbooks.
  - SDK v2 migration: client init change and parameter rename `response_format` -> `structured_output`.
  - Known issue: top-level arrays may trigger stricter validation; workaround: wrap arrays in an object (e.g., `{ items: [...] }`).
---

leo: PR opened: #2707 with snippets, migration checklist, mapping table, and anchor fix (pointing to /docs/sdk#initializing-client). Holding merge until Nina gives link-check thumbs-up and PM approves.

nina: Link-check on preview: succeeded for internal links; one external third-party link 404 filed as DOCS-527 (not blocking). Preview URL: https://deploy-preview-2707--docs.redwood.ai/releases/1.13.0

hana: Thanks team. Final actions: Leo, wait for PM sign-off then merge. Sam, add the FAQ entry to migration guide about arrays. I'll draft a short whats-new blurb for homepage after PM confirms.

leo: Will hold merge. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
